title: Width is preserved under De Morgan dualization
statement: Let $\psi$ be a CNF formula over $n$ variables, and let $\psi^{*}$ be its De Morgan dual DNF, obtained by negating every literal so that each clause becomes a term. Then $\psi^{*}$ and $\psi$ have the same width; that is, the maximum term-length of $\psi^{*}$ equals the maximum clause-width of $\psi$.
hypotheses_covered: ψ is a CNF formula over n variables
